label: Vortex (Nexus Mods)
source: field:2026-11-20 Vortex 2.8.0, started by CIG with --user-data <test folder>

isolation.userdata_why: field:2026-11-20 - ELECTRON_USERDATA must NOT equal the --user-data folder: Vortex attaches state.v2 from both, and the second attach quits with 'Database is locked'
isolation.mkdirs_why: field:2026-11-20 - without it Vortex quits at start ('unrecoverable error', ENOENT on appdata\Vortex\startup.json): an isolated launch that never reaches its main window proves nothing about isolation
isolation.source: field:2026-11-20 - Vortex 2.8 opens the DEFAULT %APPDATA%\Vortex\state.v2 for ~50 ms before it applies --user-data, and Chromium's folders never move with it. Its own end-to-end test hook (VORTEX_E2E=1) calls app.setPath('userData'/'appData') from ELECTRON_USERDATA / ELECTRON_APPDATA at module load, before the database or any window. Other effects of the hook: the single-instance lock is skipped (harmless with separate data); VORTEX_E2E_HEADLESS is a separate switch and is NOT set.
isolation.proof_required: one idle launch with a before/after byte diff of the real data folder (tools/folder_snapshot.py) before any proof run

system_side_effects.note: Even on a separate, fresh --user-data folder Vortex makes itself the nxm:// handler at start-up (seen 2026-11-20: MO2's nxmhandler.exe was replaced). CIG exports these keys before the launch and restores them when it closes the program.
